date_policy: Document revision dates always date_kind=document_revision, including rows headed Date/Release in document change histories.
Arista lifecycle train initial date has no literal 4.33 binary or 720XP/720DP assignment.
RSS announcement dates, advisory notice dates, certification dates and TOI article metadata never substitute for binary release dates.
Notice date, publisher action date and software release date stay separate; all three control dates are null.
